BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

3. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

8. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.

9. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)

   B. Information and Communication Technology
